name: Lois Denvers
source: She is [url=/c133307]Wanda's[/url] youngest daughter, [url=/c133330]Faye's[/url] younger sister, and [url=/c133331]Gene's[/url] twin sister. She is very introverted and shy, unlike her other two siblings. She attends the same school where Wanda works.
